newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Industry group says wages show rate cut need.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Industry group says wages show rate cut need.

text.p: Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry chief executive Mark Paterson said on Thursday lower-than-expected wages data meant the case for a reduction in interest rates was now beyond doubt.

"Following on from yesterday's 2.1 percent movement in the CPI (consumer price index), there can be no doubt that interest rates should come down and they should come down now," Paterson said in a statement.
He also said wage negotiations now must reflect the fact that inflation was low and likely to fall further.
"It is productivity improvement which must remain at the heart of the wage negotiation process if inflation is to remain low and interest rates are to stay permanently down," Paterson said.

Figures released earlier on Thursday showed Australian average weekly ordinary time earnings (AWOTE) for adults employed full time rose 0.7 percent in the three months to August, seasonally adjusted for an annual rise of 3.5 percent.
Data on Wednesday showed annual inflation fell to a two year low of 2.1 percent in the September quarter.
